notes.title: Version 0.50
notes.notes:
This update went for adding one of the bigger mechanics: diggable / fillable tiles which allows players to  carve out their own underground base entrance (foyer? antechamber?).

The quest and dialog response features now allows for interesting situations. Much like the general bugfixes, there's more to come!


0.50a - FEB 19 2021
=May not be compatible with saves from prior versions
+Added diggable/fillable mars base tile mechanic
+Added resource received effect
+Added saucer base_invader enemy
+Added quest chain mechanic and random event quests
+Added dynamic turret mounts
+Added dynamic dialog, adding / removing resources
+Fixed lighting settings ignoring light cookie (cloud shadows) shader
+Fixed some missing item sounds (many more yet to add)
+Fixed updated unity to 2020.2.3f1 (from 2020.2.1f1)

notes.title: 0.38 Release
notes.notes:
A new update which gets more bugs worked out but some features added as well. The starting framework is coming together. There's still more player education things as well as general content coming soon. Thanks all!

0.38 - DEC 22 2020
=May not be compatible with saves from prior versions
+Added logo and version info to start screen
+Added randomized music playing (currently only two tracks)
+Added research harvest whole option allowing specimen collection
+Added specimen required research tasks
+Added player vault and research project to unlock
+Added introduction re various gameplay (more to come)
+Added Worker / Queen favor indicator
+Added basic integration with Steam
+Added achievements
+Added steam cloud for saves
+Added base defense points
+Added UnionRep, Queen icons
+Added Post Harvest Screen button
+Balanced howlies to move slower, increased turret cannon range
+Added a skeleton of a mars enemy gib system (more to come)
+Fixed garbage can (loot destroy button) not appearing when loot picked up
+Fixed black helicopters from spawning at the exact same location at the same time
+Added allow player smash of black helicopters at ship health
+Balanced player ship repair to use Crystals instead of Harvest Material
+Fixed beam collection mode occasionally not working during earth
+Fixed dialog not appearing for introduction post earth
+Fixed improved controller functionality
+Fixed updated unity build to 2020.1.17f1 (from 2019.4.xx) fixing lighting issues
~Codebase moved onto a git suppository
~Expect additional sounds, player education in smaller incremental updates
